content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen works well—photo, headline and call link in order—but the footer repeats the business name three times and the price grid breaks the fifth item onto a lone row.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero is handsome, yet the lower sections sit in large dead bands: the opening-hours block and the story section have huge empty areas and the price grid leaves most of the row empty.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Tighten the vertical padding of the price, hours and story sections on desktop; the hours and story blocks each sit in roughly a full screen of empty dark space.","Lay out the five prices so they don't leave a lone orphan in a second row (e.g. a single column list or 5-across on desktop, 2+2+1 centred on phone).","Reduce footer repetition: the giant 'Brivnica Kos' wordmark, the bold 'Brivnica Kos' line and the logo say the same thing; keep one and merge the contact CTA with the footer address."],"blockers":[]}
